Rank 07 - Retail

Pharmacy Stock and Expiry Control

Expiry loss, batch confusion, supplier dues, and fast-moving stockouts are real pharmacy problems.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 10,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 500/month is safer than BDT 200 because product catalog and expiry support are heavier.

8.3Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 10,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 16,000,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Pharmacy reporting points to more than 220,000 licensed pharmacies. Start with small pharmacies outside premium chains.

Expired stock becomes dead loss and batch tracking is hard in notebooks.

One expired box can cost more than the monthly fee.

Validation signals

  • Pharmacy count is large.
  • Expiry loss is easy to understand.
  • Batch tracking is daily pain.
  • Owners can pay more than ordinary shops.

MVP modules

  • Medicine list
  • Batch and expiry
  • Purchase
  • Supplier due
  • Sale return
  • Near-expiry report
  • Low-stock alert

Do not build first

  • Do not give medical advice.
  • Do not build telemedicine.
  • Do not promise legal compliance without expert review.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Start with 20 pharmacies.
  • Enter top 300 products.
  • Prove near-expiry report.
  • Add barcode later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Large catalog.
  • Wrong expiry entry.
  • Formal record resistance.
Mitigations
  • Start with high-moving items.
  • Quick duplicate entry.
  • Owner-private reports.
